summary: Frontend-only Merchant Payment Dashboard (DUX IQ) mobile app tested successfully. All core features working as expected including dashboard display, KPI cards, filter tabs, bottom navigation, DUX IQ chat modal with complete flow (proactive chips, resolution, ticket creation, star rating).

issues: Close button becomes inaccessible after scrolling through long chat conversation - button is at top of modal but content scrolls down. Workaround: Escape key works to close modal.

action_items: Consider making the DUX IQ chat modal close button sticky/fixed at the top so it remains accessible after scrolling through chat messages
Optional: Add a secondary close button at the bottom of the chat modal for better UX

✓ Mock data properly structured and typed

context_for_next_testing_agent: This is a frontend-only Expo/React Native app with no backend. All data is mocked. The app is fully functional with one minor UX issue (close button accessibility in chat modal after scrolling). All features tested and working: Dashboard with merchant header (Barista Coffee, MID: 98234100001, TID: EP0000001), 4 KPI cards with correct values (₹2,450.00, 18, ₹340.50, ₹1,200.00), dark payout card, filter tabs (All, Sales, Void, Refund, Pending) working on both Dashboard and Transactions screens, bottom tab navigation (Dashboard, Transactions, Settlements, Profile), DUX IQ chat modal with complete flow including proactive chips, resolution Yes/No flow, ticket creation with correct ID format, star rating, and chat ended message.
